assets.prompt: Production raster UI asset for Plants x Plants. Use the attached approved concept ONLY as a visual style reference for its dialogue frame. Generate ONE isolated square 9-slice wooden dialogue frame asset, NOT a screenshot, NOT an asset sheet. Front-on, perfectly rectangular, axis aligned, no perspective. Warm medium terracotta-brown wooden rim with a darker brown outer outline and thin dark forest-green inner trim; restrained pixel-art wood grain. Cream parchment center MUST be a perfectly uniform flat opaque light cream color, blank and empty. Tiny bright botanical leaf clusters fixed ONLY in the four corner squares. The square frame reaches exactly the four outer canvas edges with no blank margin; corner leaves may lie within the frame's corner blocks but cannot extend outside the canvas. Outer frame/decoration thickness occupies about 12.5% of the square on each side, leaving the inner 75% x 75% center absolutely empty. The middle parts of the four edges have a straight consistent profile for stretching; decoration and complex joinery only in the corners. Pixel art suitable for a cozy botanical RPG, crisp pixels on a consistent grid, limited warm wood and green palette, no blurry texture or soft gradients, no highlights crossing the center. Aim for an original 256 by 256 pixel-art design rendered at a clean integer upscale if required. NO words, NO lettering, NO portrait, NO NPC, NO names, NO interface controls, NO dividing lines inside the center, NO backdrop, NO shadow outside the frame. This file will be sliced in code into nine regions and reused for a wide dialogue text panel, a small square portrait frame, and a nameplate.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production portrait cutout for Plants x Plants. Reference image 1 is the approved target. Faithfully recreate ONLY the gardener woman visible in its bottom right dialogue portrait. Closely match that exact small pixel-art portrait: warm straw-brown wide brim hat tilted down to viewer left, olive ribbon and a little two-leaf sprig on viewer right, wavy chestnut-brown shoulder-length hair tied loosely behind at viewer right, warm amber eyes, soft friendly closed-mouth smile, cream blouse with small collar, olive green overalls with two visible brass buckles. Match her facial proportions and the slightly angled head looking a little left toward dialogue. Do not redesign her as a chibi or anime girl, no oversized eyes, no thick black comic outlines, no exaggerated close-up. Show full hat and chest-up bust ending just below the brass buckles, both shoulders visible. Silhouette width about95% of silhouette height; head+hat about75% silhouette height, upper chest25%. Crisp intentional pixel-art on an approximately160x160 native grid, consistent pixels, restrained terracotta/brown/olive/cream palette exactly like reference. Canvas square, small transparent padding 4% around silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha outside person; no frame, no parchment, no scenery, no nameplate, no text, no drop shadow. This will be rendered about150px tall over the original cream portrait window. Accuracy to the reference is paramount, not increased illustration detail.

assets.prompt: Precise layout correction for the attached wooden dialogue asset. Preserve the artwork style and all the original decorations, but change its overall proportions to an EXTREMELY WIDE AND SHALLOW horizontal dialogue bar, SIX TIMES wider than tall, aspect ratio 6.08:1. This is absolutely critical: it must be a long low strip like the dialogue at the bottom of reference image 2, not a tall panel. Entire image is the strip itself with zero background or padding. Output target width2432 height400. Portrait window at the right must be LANDSCAPE, wider than tall, NOT vertical. Message area at left79% width. Right21% column contains shallow wide empty portrait window in its top70% and a low empty horizontal ornamental cream nameplate in lower17%. Use the delicate honey wooden borders, four leaf clusters, green inner hairline, golden portrait corner ornaments and divider rivets from the attached skin. Preserve consistent square pixel details and border thickness; recompose and redraw for wide shallow shape rather than simply flattening. Fully opaque warm cream empty interior, no text, no characters, no controls, no scenery, no whitespace around the strip. Canvas should look as wide and shallow as a web banner or a movie subtitle bar, at least six times wider than high.
assets.initial_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production raster game UI asset, not a mockup screenshot. Reference image 1 is the exact approved Plants x Plants dialogue style and proportions. Recreate ONLY its bottom dialogue wooden frame as faithfully as possible as a standalone empty UI asset. Landscape canvas EXACT aspect ratio 6.08:1, requested 2432 by 400, entire canvas occupied by the frame, no exterior backdrop or margin. The entire frame is front-on axis-aligned and rectangular. Preserve the reference's delicate warm honey/terracotta wooden rim, tiny restrained wood grain, dark forest green inner hairline, glowing warm cream parchment with very subtle texture, botanical leaves clustered at four outer corners, small wooden joint/rivet at the top and bottom of the vertical divider. Keep the reference's proportions: left blank message parchment occupies 79% width, right wooden character column 21%. The divider centered at 79% width is 1.2% canvas width. The right column contains an EMPTY cream portrait window with thin ornamental golden/cream clipped corner inlays, positioned x=82% to 96.8%, y=10% to 73%; below it a blank cream nameplate with gently clipped corners, fine brown border, golden scroll-like ends and tiny corner ornaments at x=81.3% to 97.5%, y=76% to 93%. Wooden rim around the full frame about 6% of canvas HEIGHT. Keep all these small decorations very faithful to the reference, restrained and refined, not chunky planks or heavy black outlines. Crisp cozy RPG pixel art, original base pixel grid about1216x200. Empty parchment and portrait window are opaque cream. Remove ALL text, ALL controls, continuation arrow, and the woman: no letters, no icons within message area, no portrait, no NPC or human. No scenery outside frame. Deliver one finished wide dialogue skin; do not make an atlas, sheet, square nine-slice, perspective illustration or large blank margin. Match reference as closely as possible.

assets.cleanup_prompt: Precise background-extraction edit of the attached existing production game UI skin. Remove ONLY the exterior white background and white/gray matte fringe pixels outside the wooden frame silhouette, replacing them with genuine transparent alpha. This includes the large white padding above and below the bar, tiny white wedges at its four clipped corners, and the thin white halo immediately outside its dark brown outer contour. Preserve ALL interior cream parchment areas fully opaque. Preserve the exact wooden frame, green inner trim, four leaf clusters, gold rivets/divider, empty ornamental portrait window and blank nameplate. Do not redraw, redesign, recolor, move, resize or change the proportions of any detail. Exact same very wide shallow frame, same relative portrait and nameplate placement, same colors and pixel-art detail. Keep the original canvas dimensions1933x814 if possible. Empty interior remains opaque warm cream, NOT transparent; only outside the outer dark silhouette becomes transparent. No added text, no people, no shadows, no white outline. Pixel edge alpha must be crisp, without white premultiplied halo. Deliver the same UI artwork with clean genuinely transparent exterior.

Image2 is the game's NPC sprite atlas: use the specified character's identity and clothes. One character only, full head and both shoulders, upper chest visible, looking slightly toward viewer left toward dialogue. Friendly natural expression. Square canvas with modest transparent padding, genuine transparent alpha background. Approximately160x160 native pixel grid rendered upscaled, no blurry painterly detail. No frame, text, nameplate, background, shadow, gardener hat, plants or extra characters. Subject: the male maintenance technician, the middle NPC on the bottom row of Image2 (blue cap). Warm light skin, short dark brown hair under a navy blue work cap with pale rectangular patch, brown eyes, clean-shaven approachable young adult man. Navy blue maintenance overalls with brass/copper buckles over a cream/tan work shirt and dark blue collar, matching his sprite. Calm capable slight smile. Preserve the navy/tan/copper palette; not a police officer, no badges, no weapons. End bust just below overall buckles.
